title: MVGraph: Benchmarking LVLMs on Evidence Composition across Multi-View Visual Graph
abstract: arXiv:2610.12961v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce MVGraph, a benchmark for evaluating large vision-language models (LVLMs) on multi-graph reasoning where the evidence required by a query is distributed across multiple interrelated visual graph views. Although such evidence commonly resides in source-specific graphs, temporal snapshots, or local observations, existing graph reasoning benchmarks remain confined to a single self-contained structure, assessing only graph perception and reasoning while leaving the alignment and composition of evidence across views underexplored. MVGraph comprises 8k instances spanning 8 \textit{graph-theoretic} tasks, abstracted from two multi-graph scenarios (partial and temporal graph views). Each problem is programmatically constructed and verified to be unsolvable from a single view. Beyond end-to-end evaluation, we decompose multi-graph reasoning into four complementary capabilities---Perception, Alignment, Composition, and Reasoning---an

translated_title: MVGraph：在多视图视觉图上评测大型视觉语言模型的证据组合能力
translated_abstract: 我们提出了MVGraph，这是一个用于评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）多图推理能力的基准，其中查询所需的证据分布在多个相互关联的视觉图视图中。尽管此类证据通常存在于特定来源的图、时间快照或局部观察中，但现有的图推理基准仍局限于单一的自包含结构，仅评估图感知和图推理能力，而对跨视图证据的对齐与组合的探索仍然不足。MVGraph包含8千个实例，涵盖8个图论任务，这些任务从两种多图场景（部分图视图和时序图视图）中抽象而来。每个问题均通过程序化方式构建，并被验证无法从单一视图求解。除了端到端评估之外，我们还将多图推理分解为四种互补能力——感知、对齐、组合和推理——
tldr: 提出MVGraph基准，通过8千个实例和8个图论任务评测大型视觉语言模型在多视图图推理中跨视图证据对齐与组合的能力，并将其分解为感知、对齐、组合和推理四种互补能力。
en_tdlr: MVGraph is a benchmark with 8k instances across 8 graph-theoretic tasks that evaluates LVLMs' ability to align and compose evidence distributed across multiple interrelated visual graph views, decomposing multi-graph reasoning into Perception, Alignment, Composition, and Reasoning capabilities.
